subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses: 0.5 x 10=5 Early rising is a habit of (a)_____ (get) up from bed early in the morning. An early (b)_____ (rise) can enjoy the (c)_____ (fresh) of the morning air and the (d)_____ (melody) songs of the birds. An early riser can start his/her daily work (e)_____ (early) than others. He/She does not suffer from any (f)_____ (physic) problems very often. That's why, he/she does not need to go to any (g)_____ (physic) (h)_____ (frequent). So, an early riser enjoys (i)_____ (vary) benefits and leads a (j)_____ (peace) life.
guide_solution: (a) getting (b) riser (c) freshness (d) melodious (e) earlier (f) physical (g) physician (h) frequently (i) various (j) peaceful
